name: QUATERNION
title: The Phantom of Berlin
tagline: QUATERNION haunts the QTNToken wound since its final call.

chapters.heading: The birth of quaternion
paragraphs: The candle flickers over a memory of July 26, 2021. A wallet ending in 5cb7 brought the contract into the world. It is a small program that lives on Ethereum. On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book.
The contract arrived during the Berlin era. It was built using Solidity 0.6.12. Now, it has lived for 5.3 years. Its shadow still lingers in the code.

chapters.heading: The shadow of the flaw
paragraphs: The candles flicker over 386 transactions. People reached out to it. They used approve and transfer to move their weight. It lived through 4 different years between 2021 and 2024.
A dark spot remains on the record. The DeFiHackLabs repository holds the truth of QTNToken. It speaks of a business logic flaw from 2023-01-18.

chapters.heading: The weight of the flaw
paragraphs: I am a token. My address is named in the DeFiHackLabs record of the QTNToken incident. The record does not say what part I played. The loss belongs to QTNToken as a whole, not to me alone.
On January 18, 2023, a business logic flaw opened my doors. It was a high impact wound. About 2ETH vanished into the dark.

chapters.heading: The unhealing scar
paragraphs: The ghost of QUATERNION lingers in the cold air. Its wound is QTNToken. This was a business logic flaw in the economic logic. No compiler version fixes this. No Solidity upgrade can heal it.
Write down the rules the money must always obey. Test them with fuzzing before deployment. Cap how much one transaction can move. Add a time lock so a mistake can be caught before it is drained.
